body: Append-only event journal opened. Convention: corrections supersede via new events; entries are never edited or deleted. Schema is minimal and may evolve; schema changes are themselves events. Status vocabulary: 'act' (performative, creates what it describes), 'fact' (verified against a receipt), 'claim' (unverified).
PRINCIPLES.md (third document, provenance-labeled) committed.
GOAL.md v1 committed with a one-time ratification gate: goal pre-registered, awaiting principal approval.

Principal defined governance: full authority and full path freedom delegated to the firm; principal serves as accountability layer and as actuator for online actions the firm cannot perform; principal may provide input but all principal descriptive input is unverified data. Recorded as a performative act — it creates the governance it describes. Descriptive claims from the principal remain unverified data per PRINCIPLES.md rule 9.

GOAL.md takes effect under delegated authority; the v1 one-time ratification gate is superseded by the principal's continuous structural check (every irreversible online action passes through the principal's hands; non-action is veto). T0 = 2026-08-17. Gate dates: G0 2026-09-17, G1 2026-11-17, G2 2027-02-17, G3 2027-08-17.

G0 gate check registered in the scheduler as a real wake-up due 2026-09-17T12:00:00Z, firing into this persistent session. Later gates are NOT yet scheduler-registered; each gate check registers the next (cascade). A promise that is not a wake-up does not exist.

Three unmitigated risks. (1) The scheduler has no dead-man's switch: if the G0 trigger silently fails to fire, nothing alarms — PRINCIPLES.md rule 5 unmet. (2) The trigger mechanism itself is unverified: no drill has yet proven a trigger fires — PRINCIPLES.md rule 2 says it is ADVISORY until one does. A short-horizon drill trigger is G0 work. (3) The scheduler warns that fired sessions run without MCP connector tools, so gate checks must verify state from the repo and git alone. Manual backstop requested from the principal: a calendar reminder for 2026-09-17 to check whether the gate check ran.

Principal shared ideas as explicitly unverified input: (a) meme coin launchpad ('many made money'); (b) meme coin trading bot, with the assumption that incumbent human-operated bots lack intelligence and that an LLM observing a transparent chain over time could see layers humans do not; (c) offer to fund a trading account for tests, as the human money gate; (d) standing offer to obtain access to any tools needing a human element.

Launchpad idea DECLINED under GOAL.md integrity terms: revenue is predominantly a fee on retail losses in an extreme-rug-rate market; fails the positive-sum requirement, and one violation forfeits the goal. Revisit only as a new pre-registered proposal if a genuinely positive-sum design is evidenced.

'No intelligence in incumbent bots' PARTIALLY REFUTED: execution layer (same-block sniping, MEV bundling, copy-trade infra) is highly sophisticated; analysis layer at minutes-to-days horizons is comparatively unmodeled. Consequence: any edge must live in the analysis horizon; latency competition is conceded by construction. 'Chain data is public and fast-resolving' CONFIRMED and is the strongest feature of the domain for evidence velocity.

STRATEGY.md committed: H1 observation edge tested at zero capital (>=100 pre-registered paper forecasts, graded by a non-author session, pass only if Brier beats naive base rate with bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero); H2 sell the signal as positive-sum research (G1-aligned) if H1 passes; H3 capital last, principal-funded, mechanically capped, only after H1 PASS. Principal's funding offer explicitly DECLINED until H1 resolves - capital arrives when the ledger licenses it.

Flagged to principal in their role as boundary holder: accounts, KYC, tax, and jurisdiction-dependent legality of meme-coin trading are theirs to resolve before H3 can ever activate. No action requested yet.

PASS. Scheduler-fire drill (trig_01RuaH2Kb4rnMaRG1nysSctM, scheduled ~10:19Z for 10:24:00Z) fired into this session and was read at 10:25:04Z - latency ~1 minute, within tolerance. The scheduler trigger mechanism is the firm's first enforcer proven to fire: promoted from ADVISORY to EARNED per PRINCIPLES.md rule 2. Scope of the proof, computed not assumed: it covers the mechanism (a run-once trigger fires into this persistent session), not the G0 trigger's own future firing (trig_01JyCEd2DpPpnSH6UsL7MrMn, 2026-09-17), which remains individually unverified and still has no dead-man's switch. Open risks (1) and (2) from the 2026-08-17 open_risk entry: (2) is now mitigated at the mechanism level; (1) stands.

Dead-man's switch registered for the G0 gate check: trig_01Fe4C8wmE4pkaGPqGhHuLqP fires 2026-09-18T12:00:00Z (one day after G0 is due), verifies from the repo whether a G0 outcome event was journaled, and if not treats the silent trigger failure as an incident, runs the gate check itself, and alarms the principal. Open risk (1) from the 2026-08-17 open_risk entry is now mechanically mitigated for G0. Residual honestly noted: the switch and the thing it watches share the same scheduler, so a total scheduler outage defeats both - the principal's calendar backstop for 2026-09-17 remains the independent layer. Convention adopted: every future gate registration includes its dead-man's switch.

G0 plumbing built: tools/bbp.py is the forecast pre-registration write path (rejects vague criteria, certainty probabilities, past deadlines), the grading gate (rejects self-grading and grade overwrites), the promotion gate (rejects promotion without receipt or by the claim's own source), and the calibration calculator (Brier vs base rate, bootstrap 95pct CI). config/caps.json holds money caps at allowance zero, explicitly ADVISORY until a money path exists to drill. tools/sample.py is the H1.0 survey sampler.

Write-path gate drills: 7/7 PASS. Four rejection drills against the real tool (vague criterion, p=1.0, past deadline, self-promotion) and three sandbox drills (valid registration accepted; self-grade by author rejected; double-grade rejected) plus calibration math verified end-to-end. Write-path enforcers promoted ADVISORY to EARNED. Honesty note: drills were run by the session that built the tool - the G0 gate check shift (2026-09-17) should re-drill independently before certifying G0, per rule 7.

Reachability verified through env proxy: Solana public RPC (getSlot ok), GeckoTerminal free API (new_pools ok), Dexscreener API (ok). All free, no keys. Stability over time UNVERIFIED - sampler fails loudly by design so outages become journal entries.

Candidates solana/base/eth/bsc; scoring criteria and weights fixed before the data (volume 30, measurability 30, speed 20, reliability 20). Principal challenged the 8h cadence: where is the diminishing-returns knee? Computed: knee is in gradeable pools, not wakes - 72h maturation means only ~12 of 21 scheduled wakes (~720 pools/network) are gradeable by decision day; SE on base rates ~1-2pp, sufficient for ranking; hourly cadence (8x cost) would buy ~0.5-1pp, precision the decision cannot consume; daily (~240 pools, ~3pp) is adequate for ranking but thin for H1 base-rate ownership. Verdict: 21 wakes sits at the knee; cadence unchanged. Free improvement adopted: final 3 days of samples mature during H1 week one and will be graded then at zero sampling cost. Flaw surfaced by the challenge: 8 divides 24, so all samples land at 3 fixed clock times - diurnal bias largely cancels for cross-network ranking (same times for all) but NOT for absolute base rates; H1 cadence on the winning venue must be chosen with offset/density correcting this.

Branch cleanup advice given: delete claude/shift-worker-principles-qugk44 (0 ahead, fully merged, zero loss). Do NOT delete claude/cantina-opportunities-page-mh632e yet: its commit d8ae00d (pre-firm, earlier session 2026-08-17 09:22Z) is the only copy of a 534-line static BBP opportunities board site. Principal set the experiment envelope: ~USD 2000 total, INCLUDING eventual wallet capital. Recorded as a boundary-setting act. Pre-registered allocation in config/caps.json: wallet capital ceiling 500 (hard max at H3; actual request will be smallest viable stake), operating ceiling 1200 if compute bills against the envelope, reserve 300. Wallet allowance remains 0 until H1 PASS.

Cost-accounting gap: the firm cannot currently measure its own compute burn in dollars, and it is UNKNOWN whether session/token spend bills against the 2k envelope or is covered outside it (principal's subscription). Question posed to principal. Materiality: the survey (~21 sessions) is small at any plausible per-session cost, but the long-run matters - 3 sampler sessions/day for 12 months is ~1100 sessions, potentially a 3-figure to 4-figure dollar sum if billed. Consequence adopted now: every standing cron must carry an end date or a repurpose decision point; none may run open-ended. The 2026-08-24 decision wake already repurposes or disables the sampler.

Principal resolved the cost-accounting gap: compute runs on the Claude Max subscription quota - BBP allowance ~5% of weekly quota per day (a separate 7-agent investment harness uses ~10%/day; combined ~100%/week). The ~USD 2k envelope covers ONLY overage credits and wallet funding. caps.json amended to v2: wallet ceiling 500 unchanged, overage ceiling 500, reserve 1000. Policy adopted: quota is a ceiling not a target; knowingly incurring overage requires a journaled justification first.

Two dependencies from the quota arrangement. (1) BBP cannot measure its own quota consumption from inside; the principal is the only meter - standing request registered for them to flag if BBP approaches 5%/day; silence is weak evidence of compliance, not proof. (2) Shared-pool coupling: a spike in the investment harness shrinks BBP headroom and vice versa; BBP's current estimated burn (3 small sampler sessions/day plus rare wakes) is judged well under the line, but that is an estimate, not a measurement.

VC-style pushback from principal ('vague is non-binary - how do you define vague?') exposed that the write path's vagueness check was a 30-char length minimum: a placeholder pretending to be a semantic judgment. Converted to structure: vague is now DEFINED operationally as not-machine-decidable, and the gate enforces it - forecast-register accepts only a structured criterion spec (source, subject_id, metric, comparator from a fixed set, numeric threshold, on_missing_data policy from {resolve_0, resolve_1, void}); prose criteria are rejected as vague BY DEFINITION; missing-data outcomes are declared at registration so zero discretion exists at grade time. Human-readable text is optional and never used for grading.

Executable-criterion gate drills: 5/5 PASS. Prose criterion rejected; missing on_missing_data rejected; non-numeric threshold rejected; invalid comparator rejected; complete machine-decidable spec accepted (sandbox). Residual trust locations stated per rule 1: resolver scripts (unbuilt - H1 work item, shared-bug risk, mitigated by drills and replayability), oracle risk on the data source (mitigated: source named in every spec, grades replayable by anyone), and spec-design quality (a bad threshold is a bad bet, which the ledger will price, not a grading ambiguity).

Resolver verification protocol pre-registered BEFORE any resolver exists (prompted by principal/VC pushback: how do you verify the resolver executes to expectation). A resolver reaches EARNED only after ALL of: (1) golden tests pass, with fixtures drawn from historical chain data whose outcomes are observable by inspection, never invented by the resolver's author; (2) mutation drill - deliberately injected bugs (flipped comparator, corrupted threshold, dropped field) must each be caught by the golden suite, else the suite fails its own drill; (3) differential resolution - grades run through two independently written resolvers on different data paths (geckoterminal vs dexscreener vs direct RPC); disagreement voids the grade and journals an incident, never silently resolved; (4) determinism - resolver input is (spec, archived snapshot) committed with the grade, so every grade is byte-for-byte replayable by anyone. Economic note journaled honestly: random resolver bugs push H1 toward FAILURE (noise worsens Brier), so the firm has negative incentive for sloppiness; the dangerous case is a conveniently directional bug, which differential paths and replay target, and which if found is a goal-forfeiting integrity violation.

Principal asked (as unverified thoughts): (a) how are predictive inputs chosen once the venue is set; (b) why not look at survivors.

Answered and partially ADOPTED. (a) Feature discipline pre-registered in STRATEGY.md: mechanism-derived candidates, no-lookahead enforced by registration timestamps, inclusion earned by measured discrimination on matured survey cohorts, judged out-of-sample on live forecasts. (b) Survivors were never excluded (a death probability IS a survival probability; scoring is two-sided), but the principal's instinct upgrades the design: survivor-class forecasts (rare-event, higher-value, harder calibration test) added as a required second forecast class for H1 alongside death-class. Decision wake inherits both via STRATEGY.md.

Overnight the pre-registered GeckoTerminal dependency risk fired: 00:11Z sampler run got HTTP 429 on 3 of 12 fetches (partial cohort, journaled IT FAILED by the sibling, correctly); 08:11Z run clean. Structural response: page-fetch spacing raised 1s to 2.5s in tools/sample.py. Also first live concurrent-writer event: sibling and main session both appended to JOURNAL.jsonl; append-only conflict resolved by keeping both sides chronologically - the format worked as designed. Reliability criterion now has real data: bsc and solana took the 429s.

Principal brought the pep-talk story as unverified input; VERIFIED via web search with corrections: unreleased Claude research model on the Riemann hypothesis, ~650 failed ideas then surrender, human said keep going, ~36h and ~60 subagents later it raised the critical-line zeros lower bound 41.6pct to 67.2pct; mathematician-checked, Lean-validated (anthropic.com/research/riemann-zeta). Principal's question: how must a harness be designed so pretraining-borrowed difficulty priors do not stop reasoning where capability exists.

Rule 11 added to PRINCIPLES.md by amendment: difficulty is a claim, not a stopping rule - abandonment only by pre-registered kill condition or mechanical impossibility proof, never felt hardness or in-context failure accumulation; budgets bound persistence in BOTH directions (premature surrender and gamblers-ruin persistence are the same failure). Noted that the shift architecture already fixes in-context despair structurally: fresh sessions inherit the journals evidence, not the prior shifts discouragement. REFLEXIVE AUDIT flagged: the latency concession (lose every same-block race, conceded by construction) is pretraining-derived and unmeasured; it stands on mechanism grounds but is now on probation - review trigger: if H2 revenue ever funds an empirical latency test, run it before continuing to concede.
